name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第八门 帕多尼

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第八门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第八门：100级帕多尼，约1600血。打败获得帕多尼精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先消除强化后用强攻精灵；或利用高伤害技能速攻。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
Innate special-attack boost (自身带有特攻强化), size not stated; +2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19) (the source names special attack).
reflect_damage: 4399 says it 反弹伤害 without a figure; 25% is an estimate (it may instead be a skill effect).
Level not given; 100 assumed (doors 6-7 are Lv100).
